svg.title: MealMind — Restaurant management ecosystem
svg.desc: MealMind — Restaurant management ecosystem. Status: Built. Problem: Customers, kitchen and owners each need a different live view of the same orders and payments. Approach: Three coordinated Flutter apps on one Firebase backend. A confirmed payment reaches the chef screen and admin dashboard in under a second. Highlights: Full Razorpay payment lifecycle: webhook → Cloud Function → every app; One Firestore write drives the customer, chef and admin views; Firebase security rules scoped per role — built in, not bolted on; CI/CD with GitHub Actions for all three apps. Stack: Flutter ×3, Firestore, Firebase Auth, Cloud Functions, Razorpay, GitHub Actions.
